sentences.text: Keith Lionel Urban -LRB- born 26 October 1967 -RRB- is a New Zealand-born Australian country musician .	New Zealand	New Zealand
In 1991 , he released a self-titled debut album and charted four singles in Australia before moving to the United States the following year .	self-titled debut album	Keith Urban (1991 album)

He found work as a session guitarist before starting a band known as The Ranch , which recorded one studio album on Capitol Nashville and charted two singles on the Billboard Hot Country Songs chart .
